note: Both sets are heavily redundant, but Set A's core readings are correct: full points at 5.000 lb/80 oz, reduced points between 16 and 80 oz with linear scaling, no points at or below 16 oz/450 g, and the 96.00 oz (2.721 kg) minimum starting weight in a single container. Set A's clear errors are two invented figure readings (claiming 0 points at 80 oz and at 20 oz, when 80 oz is full points and 20 oz is in the reduced range). Set B invents a quote ('starting water weight shall be 6.00 lb'), misstates the guest list as eight people per neighboring house rather than eight total (two from each of three houses plus up to two VIPs), and wrongly describes the scoring function as a linear increase from 0 to 80 oz when it is flat below 16 oz. Set A also captures the Dinner Party score range and guest composition correctly, which Set B gets partly wrong.
